articles.title: Cisco Gave All 90,000 Employees Their Own AI Agent
articles.summary: Networking-equipment maker Cisco rolled out a personal AI agent for all of its 90,000 global employees this week.  The AI agent, called MyAgent, is personalized to each employee,  Cisco  Executive Vice President of Operations Thimaya Subaiya recently told me in an exclusive interview.  Cisco’s AI agent program is one of the first examples of a widespread agent rollout inside a large company, and one where the autonomous bots are set to accomplish a variety of tasks on behalf of their humans.
